Long Description: AtelAI is an AI-powered fashion platform that enables users to instantly generate custom-fit sewing patterns from design images and body measurements using generative AI and 3D scanning. The platform connects users directly with skilled sewers and artisans, allowing them to produce personalized garments while supporting cultural expression and ethical production.This service addresses key challenges in the fashion industry: the high cost and time of pattern making, the overproduction caused by standardized sizing, and the loss of traditional craftsmanship. It also reduces reliance on exploitative fast fashion systems and supports slow, inclusive fashion creation.Our target includes design-conscious consumers, small apparel brands, independent designers, and skilled sewers seeking flexible income. By lowering technical barriers and enabling cultural storytelling through clothing, AtelAI empowers a broader, more diverse range of people to participate in fashion creation.

Long Description: We aim to create a next-generation interface that bridges humans and technology. In our vision, technology deeply understands people—where context, emotional, and physical states become meaningful inputs, enabling systems to deliver the right support, information, or service at the right time, based on what truly benefits each individual.　In the short term, we are building a robust data infrastructure that empowers individuals to retain full control over their sensitive personal data—such as health, behavior, and contextual information—while unlocking hyper-personalized experiences across industries. Short Description: Chiral, is developing a collaborative no-code platform to help researchers accelarate drug discovery with AI
Long Description: Chiral offers a drug discovery platform designed to streamline in-silico drug discovery for pharmaceutical companies. It allows users to build, compare, and optimize multiple virtual screening pipelines, integrating various applications (e.g., Protenix, GNINA) and databases (e.g., Enamine).The core problem Chiral solves is the fragmentation and complexity of current in-silico tools, which leads to wasted resources (20-40% of the $11 billion annual spend) and high wet lab failure rates. By enabling easy comparison and deployment of different drug discovery applications, Chiral aims to improve the quality of in-silico hits and reduce downstream failures.

Short Description: CLOVERNA, is developing a DIRAC/dCas13-powered RNA drug-discovery platform and ASO pipeline to help biopharma partners and clinicians rapidly identify and translate functional non-coding RNA targets into first-in-class therapeutics.
Long Description: CLOVERNA is a preclinical-stage biotech company developing first-in-class RNA-targeted therapeutics using its proprietary CRISPR/dCas13-based screening platform, DIRAC. This function-first engine identifies novel RNA targets—especially non-coding regions—expanding the RNA druggable space beyond traditional methods. Our lead candidate, CLV-201, is an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) that inhibits TDP-43 aggregation by targeting disease-specific RNA interactions in motor neurons—a hallmark of sporadic ALS.

Short Description: CrowdChem is building a deep-tech federated AI solution that empowers industries worldwide to unlock faster, smarter material and chemical breakthroughs by transforming siloed data into secure, game-changing innovation
Long Description: CrowdChem tackles one of the biggest barriers in science: valuable chemical data locked in silos across industries, academia, and regions. Our deep-tech solution uses federated learning and advanced graph neural networks to unify over 1.3M+ data sources without ever compromising IP security. We are developing a solution that allows companies to predict properties, optimise designs, and uncover root causes in minutes instead of weeks. By connecting sectors from cosmetics to aerospace, CrowdChem is accelerating global innovation and reshaping how materials are discovered and deployed.

Short Description: digzyme is developing novel, computer-designed recombinant enzymes to help food and material industries advance planetary and human health by designing feasible enzyme processes and expanding biocatalysis into previously impractical areas.
Long Description: Enzymes are catalytic proteins produced by living organisms, with over 10 million natural sequences registered in public databases. Biomanufacturing uses enzymatic reactions through fermentation or enzyme-based processes and is gaining attention for its potential in a carbon-neutral society. Synthetic biology requires testing many enzyme combinations, but most database-listed enzymes have unknown functions. This makes untested combinations risky, so development often relies on safe, well-known enzymes—limiting innovation.Our platform, digzyme Moonlight, solves this by predicting enzyme functions using simulations and bioinformatics, even with limited data. It enables discovery of novel enzyme genes and design of new enzyme processes to meet unmet industrial needs. It has delivered results in areas like plastic recycling and new food material development.Our services range from computational analysis to supplying recombinant enzyme samples and supporting scale-up. We are also building compliant systems for food-grade enzyme production in Japan, and planning future in-house or OEM-based manufacturing and sales.

Our vision is to redesign human I/O for the next century, extending the boundaries of human cognition. Now we're working on developing digital brain platform and physiological foundation model using wearable devices, with universities and corporate research institutes.

Short Description: MiRNDa, Inc. is a start-up aiming to realize a world where cancer can be cured through the social implementation of cancer screening with our proprietary RNA modification technology.
Long Description: Aiming to realize a world where cancer can be cured through the social implementation of cancer screening with our proprietary RNA modification technology from one of the National Institutes in Japan. The technology theoretically works for early cancer detection (Stage 0/I/II) for all of the cancer types with high accuracy. In fact, we demonstrated 95% of accuracy for pancreatic cancer detection from retrospective study, that was published on Nature Communications in 2019. We recognize that our technology for cancer detection is based on “Quality of RNA”, not “Quantity of RNA, DNA, and Protein” which are currently the available technologies from other companies in the market, that comparatively can work for detecting cancers at late stage with high accuracy. Now we advance product and business development toward the social implementation of screening services for cancers with high unmet medical needs in daily clinical practices, starting with pancreatic cancer, that has a particularly low 5-year survival rate. Following pancreatic cancer markers, the cancers of the liver and gallbladder, which are silent organs, are the next targets and then we are going to expand to 5 primary cancer types, lung, colonial, stomach, breast and cervical cancers.

Short Description: NanoResonance is developing Resonance Color — a revolutionary pigment platform — to help global industries replace heavy, toxic colorants with ultra-light, safe, and vivid colors powered by perfectly spherical silicon nanoparticles.
Long Description: The silicon nanoparticles we have developed are an innovative material that develops colors based on a completely different principle than conventional color materials, and can make paints significantly lighter.The advantages of this color material are as follows;1. Lightest Weight (leads to reduce CO2 emission and improve fuel economy)2. Robust (over 500 °C resistance and UV cut)3. Sustainable (only use silicon with very small amount)This material has overwhelmingly high colorability and opacity, and can reduce the thickness of conventional coating films to 1/10. In addition, full color can be produced with a single material, silicon, and because it is a type of structural color, it does not fade in principle. In addition, silicon's outstanding weather resistance makes it applicable to all kinds of materials.We aim to produce silicon nanoparticles and paints with them and sell to automobiles and cosmetics industries.

Short Description: oto is developing a decentralized app that securely collects and anonymizes everyday voice conversations to help AI companies build next-generation voice assistants.
Long Description: There is almost no data of real-life conversations on the internet. This means speech-AI training data is drastically scarcer than text—something we have verified empirically. oto is a project that pairs a wearable voice-capture device with a smartphone app to turn daily conversations around the world into structured data. For speakers of major languages, oto unlocks personalized services—automatic task management, meeting notes, health insights. For under-represented languages and heavy accents, users can monetize their uploads by licensing data to AI firms. These incentives let us map global conversation flow, creating a speech-based Google Trends or Maps.The vision is turning the world's conversation into data.The main problem we solve is the lack of training data for voice AI. Only 2% of the world’s languages are supported by voice AI. Even in English, recognition accuracy drops when it comes to accents or dialects. The solution is simple: Put on your smartphone or oto’s wearable, and let it capture your daily conversations.
